trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

- **Root cause:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back all three production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that was healthy in production.
- **Verification:** Confirmed v2.3.0 is now deployed in all regions, service is healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
